# Life Ledger · Deep Review 1.1

Life Ledger 1.1 makes daily reflection easier without letting AI silently change the record.

## Quick record

The self-hosted Cloudflare edition now places one quiet microphone button inside Daily Reflection. Speak for up to ten minutes, review the original transcript and the refined draft, edit anything you want, then explicitly append it to today's journal.

Cloudflare Workers AI performs both transcription and multilingual refinement. No separate API key is required. Raw audio is processed transiently and is never stored in browser state, D1, synchronization payloads, backups, or application logs.

## Guardrails

- Available only in an authenticated self-hosted Cloudflare deployment
- Three requests and 20 recorded minutes per account per UTC day
- Existing journal text is appended to, never silently replaced
- Habits, moods, and goals are not changed by the model
- Manual journaling remains available when voice or provider allowance is unavailable

## Upgrade

Export a complete JSON backup, deploy the new commit, and allow the `0002_voice_usage.sql` migration to run. Installed PWAs use a new 1.1 cache shell and should update automatically after reopening.

The previous stable source remains available at tag `v1.0.0`; maintainers also created `backup/pre-voice-reflection-20260822` as an explicit rollback point before this feature.
